dedupe_keys.name: statistics iceland census 2021 dwelling and household car tables by municipality statistical output area and minor output area pxweb

description: Statistics Iceland publishes the results of the register based Census 2021 in its PxWeb statistical database, with tables that go down to 207 minor statistical output areas. The housing folder holds ten tables: living quarters by municipality and region; conventional dwellings by period of construction and by type of building for 44 statistical output areas; dwellings by building material, owner type and region; and four tables of dwelling characteristics by minor output area, output area, municipality and region, with the number of conventional dwellings, share in buildings with three or more dwellings, vacancy rate, rental share, share with less than 15 m2 per person, share built in the last five years, average floor space, inhabitants per dwelling, average age and rooms. A household folder adds tenure, employed persons and number of cars by the same areas for 2011 and 2021. Coverage is national. The census counted 130,849 households; the housing release reports that the share of empty dwellings went from 6.6% to 10.1% between 2011 and 2021 and covers dwellings of 25 m2 or more only. Format and access: free PxWeb tables with download in several formats, no registration; the PxWeb API returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) when tried, while the HTML pages worked. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: no water, sewer or heating variables in these tables; 1981 and 2011 comparisons exist only at municipality and region level. Simulation uses: small-area dwelling stock and age for exposure and retrofit models, vacancy for demand, and household car ownership for road and transit demand. Related records: the Estonia REL2021 dwelling and commuting tables and the Hungary census 2022 dwelling series.
